extracted.name: Scottish lentil soup
extracted.description: Make our hearty Scottish lentil soup for a warming lunch. Perfect for chilly days, it's packed with red lentils and vegetables, and you can also add ham hock
ingredient_lines: 300g ham hock roughly chopped or shredded (optional)
instruction_lines: Pour the stock in a large saucepan with the carrots, onion, swede and lentils. Season well, then simmer over a medium heat for about 40 mins. Add the potatoes and cook for a further 20 mins until the potatoes have cooked through and the lentils have collapsed.
Stir in the ham, if using, and cook for a few minutes to reheat. Season to taste, scatter over the chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread.
